name: assumption-registry-builder
title_zh: 给 Excel 模型建一张假设登记表
tagline_zh: 模型里那些拍脑袋填的数字，散在几十个 sheet 里没人认领。它把每个假设拉出来登记：名称、类别、基准值、出处。
tagline_en: Every hardcoded guess in your model gets a name, a source, a Bull/Bear range and an owner — plus a formula that.
desc_en: Creates a structured assumption register for any Excel model with columns for name, category, base value, source, Bull/Bear values, sensitivity rank, and owner, plus a formula for computing sensitivity rank from Data Table outputs.
why_zh: 敏感度排名不是手填的，是从 Data Table 结果反算出来的，所以谁真正撬动估值一目了然。
why_en: Sensitivity rank is computed from Data Table outputs rather than typed in, so the assumptions that actually move the model.
limit_zh: 只产出登记表结构和排名公式，不替你判断哪个假设该填多少；敏感度排名依赖你模型里已有可用的 Data Table 输出。
limit_en: Outputs the register structure and ranking formula only — it won't pick your values, and sensitivity ranking needs existing Data Table outputs or.
title_en: Build an assumption register for any Excel model
